propositions: Agents file bugs outside epic hierarchy that are defects in the epic's deliverable, and the direct-children close gate cannot detect them because they are not structurally direct children.

Open bugs with a caused_by edge targeting the epic or its descendants must deterministically block epic close, enforced as a cheap deterministic floor tier by reading the bug's own deps[] for reverse-edge targets in the epic-subtree id set.

Candidate filter must identify open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first open→in_progress transition OR linked to the epic subtree (any relation, both directions), anchored on retired STATUS events when available, capped at 32 candidates with overflow tally.

Screen must apply single-turn forced-choice haiku relevance (A: defect in epic deliverable; B: pre-existing/adjacent; C: unrelated) using shared model-class config and cache settings, forwarding at most 8 A-verdicts as compact evidence into the verifier's precheck context.

Verifier must block only undispositioned deliverable-defects, satisfied via store-grounded signals: supersedes/duplicates link (either direction) or reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose in bug description/comments, never via close_class.

Screen failure and unresolved-candidate overflow must degrade open with logged reason and tally recording; DET floor remains the hard block tier; screen output rides normalizing validator with safe-default coercion to C (unrelated).
